title: Armstrong Number
description:
Write a Java program to check if a given number is an Armstrong number or not.

Input number: 153
Output: "Yes, the number is an Armstrong number."

description:
Write a Java program to reverse a given string without using built-in reverse methods.

Input: "hello"
Output: "olleh"

title: Employee Salary Management
description:
A company wants to manage employee salaries. Write a Java program that:
1. Reads employee details (name, id, basic salary)
2. Calculates HRA (20% of basic) and DA (10% of basic)
3. Prints the gross salary

Sample Input:
Name: John, ID: 101, Basic: 50000

Sample Output:
Gross Salary: 65000.0

title: Bank Account System (Inheritance & Polymorphism)
description:
Design a Bank Account system demonstrating inheritance and polymorphism.

Requirements:
- Base class Account with deposit() and withdraw() methods
- Derived classes SavingsAccount and CurrentAccount with different interest/overdraft rules
- Demonstrate runtime polymorphism by calling methods through a base class reference

title: Library Management System
description:
Design a complete Library Management System with the following features:
1. Add/remove books
2. Issue and return books with due-date tracking
3. Calculate fines for overdue books
4. Search books by title/author
5. Maintain a list of members and their borrowed books

Use proper OOP principles: encapsulation, inheritance where applicable, and collections (List/Map) to manage state.
